validity.recommendation: pipeline existence verified; LNG terminal link confirmed
validity.researcher_notes: Point Comfort Pipeline was a proposed 27-mi gas pipeline intended to feed the Calhoun LNG (Gulf Coast LNG) import terminal at Point Comfort, Texas. The terminal and associated pipeline were cancelled by FERC on February 21, 2013. Pipeline existence confirmed via Hydrocarbons Technology project profile and Reuters February 2013 FERC cancellation notice. Termini: Port Lavaca/Point Comfort area to Tennessee Gas pipeline connection. Route geometry (27 coordinates) in routes repo confirms 27-mi corridor. Operator/owner: Gulf Coast LNG Partners LP. Cancellation is sourced and dated; project never constructed.
